_meta.purpose: Runtime semantics per effect tag: what the engine DOES with a stored record. Complements 46 (write shapes). Absorbed into 46 v3 when extraction completes.
_meta.provenanceRule: Every entry cites file:line from the drop. UNVERIFIED entries are absent, not guessed.
_meta.status: EXTRACTION CLOSED. Combat engine (tags, spine, consequences, action layer) + batch 6 (router census in 48, ai_v2 behavior layer, drain, durability constants, bloodline/skillTree init).

sequence: 1. Ground effects convert to user effects for users standing on the tile (sorted by sortEffects). Damage-type ground effects also forwarded to barriers.
2. mirror and copy realize FIRST so their products join usersEffects this pass.
3. Non-damage-modifier effects apply in sortEffects order.
4. Damage-modifier pipeline (dedicated loop): multiplicative IDG/IDT buckets, then shared sequential percentage DR, then static DR, then bloodline increases.
5. pierce: after damage modifiers, before post-damage family (bypasses mitigation by ordering).
6. POST_PIERCE_TAGS read post-mitigated damage: lifesteal, drain, poison, afterburn, absorb, recoil, reflect, wound, decreaseheal, increaseheal.
7. Heal-modifier effects run after the post-damage family (they modify lifesteal_hp / absorb_hp / vampRatio already set).
_spine_applyEffects_order.tiebreak: Within decreasedamagetaken and decreasedamagegiven: static sorts BEFORE percentage (util.ts:1135-1146).

R1_bloodline_self_target.law: Bloodline effects are realized at battle init with targetId = the bearer, unconditionally. Effect polarity is the ONLY thing deciding help vs harm: any offensive tag (damage, poison, stun, ...) in a bloodline effects array attacks its own bearer as a per-round residual. CORRECTED 2026-08-01 batch 6: this is NOT the same path as skill tree - see R47. Additional riders: (a) bloodline effects are suppressed entirely in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING; (b) bloodline.update strips `rounds` and `friendlyFire` from every effect before writing, so bloodline effects are permanent and friendlyFire never persists on them.
R1_bloodline_self_target.consequence: Bloodline arrays may carry defensive or buff polarity tags ONLY. Damage intent expresses as increasedamagegiven, never damage. Never rely on rounds for a bloodline effect.
R1_bloodline_self_target.incident: Beehive bloodline, damage tag as passive, self-residual every round (dauntless, 2026-08-01)

R2_ranked_exclusion.law: Bloodline AND skill tree effects are NOT added in battleType RANKED_PVP or RANKED_SPARRING.

R3_static_heal_x10.law: Static heal = (power + level*powerPerLevel) * applyTimes * 10. The x10 is hardcoded. Percentage heal = maxPool * power/100 * applyTimes. To hit a flat target value with a static heal, write power = target/10.
R3_static_heal_x10.asymmetry: Static DAMAGE has no x10: damageCalc returns dmg = power for calculation static. Same field, 10x different meaning per tag.

R4_residual_timing.law: rounds=0: effect applies on the CAST round only (castThisRound gate). rounds>0: applies ONLY on FOLLOWING rounds, never the cast round. A rounds>0 heal/damage is a pure residual.
R4_residual_timing.source: tags.ts:1621-1633 (heal consequence gate; same pattern in damage path)

R5_residualModifier.law: residualModifier multiplies damage only when !castThisRound (residual ticks). dmgModifier (e.g. from weakness) multiplies always.

R6_getPower.law: Effective power = power + level * powerPerLevel. For calculation=percentage the result is HARD-CAPPED at 100. Applies to every tag via getPower.

R7_prevent_round_gate.law: UNIVERSAL (generalizes old R7): preventCheck only consults prevents that are (a) NOT castThisRound - a prevent is inert the round it lands, active from the next round - and (b) createdRound < the incoming effect's createdRound. Effects predating the prevent, or landing the same round, pass.

R8_persistent_sources.law: CONFIRMED FULL SET: clear/cleanse cannot remove effects whose fromType is in {bloodline, armor, accessory, keystone, skill, ranked, village}. 'item' is NOT in the set: consumable-sourced effects ARE strippable. Ground effects at the target's tile of matching polarity are ALSO removed on a successful clear/cleanse.

R9_formula_damage.law: calculation=formula: dmg = powerEffect(totalAtk, totalDef, level, power, config); stats contribute sqrt(stat) * stats_scaling, generals sqrt(gen) * gen_weight; advantage ratio curve clamped [advantage_min, advantage_max]; baseline = calcHP(attackerLevel)/base_hits; epScale = power/ep_normalization. Confirms 50_DATA pipeline.

R10_prevent_stick_or_fizzle.law: Every prevent handler (all 12) rolls power/100 ONCE on application. Success: the tag's power is promoted to 100 - a hard block for its remaining duration. Failure while isNew: rounds=0, the tag dies instantly. After sticking, preventCheck's own power/100 roll is vacuously guaranteed. Prevents are a coin-flip on arrival, then binary.
R10_prevent_stick_or_fizzle.consequence: Prevent power below 100 is a gamble on application, not a partial resistance. Power 100 = always sticks.
R10_prevent_stick_or_fizzle.source: tags.ts: healPrevent 1636, fleePrevent 1560, stunPrevent 2949, sealPrevent 2485, buffPrevent 196, + 7 more; 14x 'effect.power = 100' pattern

R11_immunity_is_antiprevent.law: The immunity tag counters PREVENTS: it carries a 'blocks' field naming a tag type; when a new prevent of that type lands on the immune target, immunity sets its rounds=0 before it can stick.

R12_clear_cleanse_model.law: clear strips POSITIVE effects (enemy buffs), cleanse strips NEGATIVE (own debuffs); each gated by its own prevent (clearprevent/cleanseprevent). Model: roll power/100 each round the tag lives; failure re-rolls next round; success executes removal immediately (sets matching effects' rounds=0), then the tag self-terminates. Power 100 = instant guaranteed strip.

R13_copy_semantics.law: copy: one-shot power/100 roll on cast. Copies ONLY {increasedamagegiven, increasestat, decreasedamagetaken, reflect, shield} and ONLY jutsu-sourced instances - fromTypes {bloodline, armor, accessory, keystone, item, village, skill} are excluded. Copied effect targets the copier, lives for the COPY tag's rounds, dedups per source effect while a live copy exists. Gated by buffprevent on the COPIER.
R13_copy_semantics.runtime_note: Handler is entity-agnostic: an item-carried copy tag would execute. Only the write-path legality (H01) remains open.

R14_mirror_semantics.law: mirror: one-shot power/100 roll. COPIES (does not remove) the caster's own jutsu-sourced NEGATIVE effects onto the target; same seven excluded fromTypes as copy; additionally cannot mirror {damage, pierce, clear, buffprevent, cleanseprevent, moveprevent, healprevent, wound, timecompression}. Gated by debuffprevent on the TARGET. Dedup per source effect.

R15_redirection_positional.law: redirection is POSITIONAL, not probabilistic: power = number of hex tiles to move the target. direction field 'pull' (default) or 'push' along the caster-target axis; pull stops 1 tile short of the caster; landing on occupied tiles is adjusted. Gated by moveprevent on the target. CRITICAL: fires only when rounds===0 && isNew && castThisRound - a redirection written with rounds>0 is COMPLETELY INERT.

R16_efficiency_tag_overlap.law: Reactive tags (reflect/absorb family) apply to incoming damage only if they share at least one statType/generalType/element with it (binary 0/1 gate; empty elements count as 'None' and match other 'None'). EXCEPTION: pierce damage ALWAYS matches - pierce bypasses damage modifiers but is always reflectable/absorbable.

R17_stun_two_dials.law: stun: power = one-shot application chance (fail while isNew = tag dies); apReduction = AP drained per round once stuck. Two independent dials. A stun without apReduction self-kills as 'inactive'. AP consumption site: actions/process (batch 5).

R18_seal_bloodline_only.law: seal disables ONLY effects with fromType='bloodline' (sealCheck). Skill-tree, item, armor, and jutsu effects are UNTOUCHED by seal. Power = one-shot application chance.

R19_time_effects.law: timecompression/timedilation: the 10 AP delta is HARDCODED; power is only the application chance. Element-scopable via elements[] (empty = all jutsu). Non-stacking: a second instance on the same target dies on arrival. Compression gates on debuffprevent, dilation on buffprevent.

R20_weakness_matching.law: weakness matches incoming damage/pierce by ANY of five routes: jutsu id in jutsus[], item id in items[], element overlap, statType overlap, generalType overlap. The multiplier is the dmgModifier FIELD (power is only the application roll). Only the single highest-power matching weakness applies - weaknesses NEVER stack. Applies to pierce as well as damage.

R21_onehitkill.law: onehitkill rolls power/100 on EVERY processing pass (no cast-round gate) and on success sets curHealth=0 directly. onehitkillprevent counters via the standard stick-or-fizzle model.

R22_rob_pvp_only.law: rob: dead vs AIs and dead outside battleType COMBAT (open-world 1v1) - no sparring, ranked, or quest battles. robPercentage = % of target pocket money taken; power = success chance per tick; supports instant (rounds=0) or per-round residual grammar.

R23_clone.law: clone is a GROUND effect spawning a copy of the CASTER at the tile: ALL 12 stats multiplied by power/100 (power 50 = half-stat clone). isSummon/isAi, controllerId = caster.

R24_summon.law: summon spawns the stored AI (aiId) at the tile: stats scaled by power/100 but HP = the tag's aiHp field (NOT scaled). The summon's own bloodline effects are realized onto it at spawn. Dedup: will not spawn while a live same-name summon of the caster exists. Fires once (isNew && castThisRound).

R25_shield.law: shield: power = creation chance; on success effect.power is REPURPOSED to hold the pool from the health field, decremented by absorbed damage, destroyed at <=0. Write shape needs BOTH power (chance) and health (pool).

R26_finalstand.law: finalstand: 1-HP floor while live. power/100 re-rolled on EVERY pass; the first failed roll ends it - power<100 means a per-round chance to drop, not a one-time gate.

R27_markers.law: stealth, elementalseal, disarm, immunity are marker tags consumed elsewhere: stealth (targeting exclusion) and elementalseal (blocks casting listed-element jutsu) roll power on application; disarm blocks weapon use via the prevent stick-or-fizzle model; immunity applies unconditionally with its blocks field (R11). Consumption sites: actions/ai_v2 (batch 5).

R28_reactive_timing.law: absorb, reflect, recoil, afterburn, lifesteal, and the healgiven modifiers ALL fire only when !isNew && !castThisRound: a reactive tag does NOTHING the round it is cast and must pre-exist the triggering damage. Exception: wound, which snapshots on its cast round and ticks after.

R29_absorb.law: absorb converts incoming post-mitigation packets to pool restore: static = min(power, packetDamage) per packet; percentage = packet x power/100; split EVENLY across poolsAffected; efficiency-ratio gated; healprevent-gated (absorb IS a heal).

R30_reflect.law: reflect returns floor(min(power, packet) or packet x power/100) x efficiencyRatio to the attacker; buffprevent-gated (pre-existing prevents only).

R31_barrier_model.law: barrierAbsorb (from the barrier crossed) is the split fraction: the barrier takes damage computed against a PHANTOM DEFENDER whose level = the barrier's power (stats scaled from level); the target's INSTANT packet is multiplied by (1 - barrierAbsorb). RESIDUAL ticks are never reduced by barriers. Barrier dies at curHealth<=0.

R32_wound.law: wound snapshots the caster's total damage to the target ON ITS CAST ROUND (timeTracker.originalDamage), then each remaining round on the target's turn deals snapshot x power/100. A wound cast in an action that deals no damage snapshots ZERO and ticks zero forever - wound must ride the same action as its damage.

R33_recoil.law: recoil is a DEBUFF on an enemy: when they deal damage they take min(power, packet) or packet x power/100 back, efficiency-gated. PIERCE packets are EXEMPT. Per-packet value is assigned, not accumulated - multiple recoils do not stack on one packet.

R34_afterburn.law: afterburn accumulates per incoming packet up to a HARD ENGINE CAP of 60% of that packet's damage (confirms the doctrine rule as source law, per-packet). PIERCE packets are EXEMPT.

R35_lifesteal_vamp.law: lifesteal on a unit converts power% of damage THEY DEAL into lifesteal_hp for the dealer (self-cast = your hits heal you). Percentage-only math; healprevent-gated; NO pierce exemption - lifesteal triggers off pierce packets. vamp is the ratio-based variant via vampRatio - applied INSIDE the damage block at ratio x packet, drawing from the shared leech budget FIRST (before lifesteal).

R36_poison.law: poison deals power% of the CHAKRA + STAMINA THE TARGET SPENDS per action (after increase/decreasepoolcost modifiers) as damage. It is spend-punishment, not a flat DoT: a target who stops casting takes nothing; expensive actions hurt most. Cast round is announcement only. Debuffprevent-gated.

R37_drain.law: drain (PARTIAL): residual-only per-round pool drain keyed off the target's MAX pools across poolsAffected; debuffprevent-gated; one consequence per target.

R38_healgiven_modifiers.law: increase/decreasehealgiven adjust heal_hp, lifesteal_hp, AND vampRatio on packets dealt by their target: percentage scales, static adds FLAT power (no x10 here - the x10 is only in the base static heal), and static on vampRatio converts as power/100.

R39_consequence_order.law: Per collapsed packet, pools are hit in this order: damage -> vamp heal -> armor durability loss -> residual -> wound -> afterburn -> reflect (to attacker) -> recoil (to attacker) -> lifesteal (to attacker) -> absorb hp/sp/cp (to defender). Every step floors health at 0 and caps heals at max.

R40_leech_budget.law: DAMAGE_LEECH_CAP_RATIO = 0.6: vamp and lifesteal SHARE a per-packet budget of 60% of pre-shield damage. Vamp draws first; lifesteal gets the remainder. Combined leech from one hit can never exceed 60% of it. Neither fires if the leecher is at 0 HP; lifesteal also requires the target alive.

R41_stun_consumption.law: Stun AP drain: calcApReduction takes the MAX apReduction across all live stuns on the user (including ground-tile stuns passing friendlyFire) - stuns NEVER stack; the biggest wins. Model: stored actionPoints reset to 100 each round; stun subtracts from AVAILABLE AP; canAct requires available-after-cost >= 0.

R42_armor_durability.law: Every direct-damage, residual, AND wound packet costs 1 durability on each equipped ARMOR piece of the victim - three independent decrements per turn if all three land, so DoT-heavy fights burn armor ~3x. At durability <= DURABILITY_USABILITY_THR (= 0) the piece auto-unequips mid-fight. NO_DURABILITY_LOSS_COMBATS = ['SPARRING']: every other battle type (QUEST, RAID, RANDOM_ENCOUNTER, PVP, ...) is lossy. CONSTANTS PINNED batch 6.

R43_stealth_consumption.law: Stealth = pacifist invisibility: a stealthed user cannot be targeted (self-targeting still allowed), AND the stealthed user's own damage-tagged jutsu are filtered from their action list - you cannot attack from stealth.

R44_disarm_consumption.law: Disarm filters weapon-required jutsu from the action list and hides equipped weapons for the duration.

R45_barrierAbsorb_assignment.law: barrierAbsorb on an attack is set from the crossed barrier's absorbPercentage field; crossing multiple barriers ACCUMULATES totalAbsorb. The barrier write shape's absorbPercentage is the split dial R31 consumes.

R46_absorb_clamp_quirk.law: SOURCE QUIRK: stamina and chakra absorb clamp against target.maxHEALTH, not maxStamina/maxChakra (process.ts copy-paste artifact). Pool-converted absorbs on high-HP low-pool builds can overfill relative to intent.

R47_skilltree_targeting.law: Skill tree effects are NOT unconditionally self-targeting. SkillTree.target selects the path: SELF realizes at init on the bearer (identical to bloodline, polarity law applies). ALLIES/ENEMIES defer to a second init pass that realizes each effect against EVERY living combatant (bearer included) and filters per-tag with checkFriendlyFire on the tag's friendlyFire field: FRIENDLY = same direction, ENEMIES = different direction, unset or ALL = passes for everyone. A skill with target ENEMIES whose tags omit friendlyFire hits the entire field including the bearer and allies. Skill effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP/RANKED_SPARRING. Unlike bloodline, skillTree.update does NOT strip rounds/friendlyFire - both persist and friendlyFire is load-bearing.
R47_skilltree_targeting.consequence: Offensive tags ARE legal on skill tree entries iff target is ENEMIES AND every offensive tag carries friendlyFire: 'ENEMIES'. Lint: skillTree entry with target ALLIES/ENEMIES must have friendlyFire set on every tag.
R47_skilltree_targeting.source: combat.ts:2717-2760 (SELF + pending push), combat.ts:3071-3095 (pending pass), process.ts:140-169 (checkFriendlyFire), skillTree.ts update (no strip)

R48_drain_runtime.law: Drain: percentage => floor(power/100 * target MAX pool) per pool in poolsAffected (default [Health]); static => flat power, NO x10 (heal's x10 is unique to heal). No tick on the cast round (isNew/castThisRound skip); ticks on subsequent rounds while rounds > 0, so effective ticks = rounds - 1 relative to naive expectation. Bypasses the entire damage-modifier pipeline (direct pool subtraction, not damage), yet the HP branch credits damage_dealt to the drainer. Multi-drainer quirk: consequences merge by targetId keeping the FIRST creatorId, so a second drainer's share goes uncredited (shared collapseConsequences limitation).

R49_ai_distance_semantics.law: AI rule 'distance' is A* PATH LENGTH on the hex grid (path node count incl. endpoints), not hex distance: an ADJACENT enemy reads distance 2. Both conditions are inclusive (distance_higher_than: >=, distance_lower_than: <=). Occupied tiles cost 100 so paths detour around bodies, inflating distance in crowded fields. Gate formula: a jutsu with range R needs distance_lower_than: R+1. Engine's own backup rules confirm (move while >=2, strike while <=2).
R49_ai_distance_semantics.consequence: Guide 24 'distance gate matching the jutsu range' is off by one. Lint: every use_specific_jutsu/item rule's distance_lower_than value should equal action range + 1 (warn on == range: a melee gate of 1 can NEVER fire).

R50_ai_condition_quirks.law: has_effect / target_has_effect with threshold 0 return TRUE unconditionally (explicit early-return) - a no-op condition, not 'has any'. Use threshold >= 1 to actually test presence. Threshold compares against the SUM of matching effects' power on the target. Max threshold 100.

R51_barrier_between_dead_target.law: BARRIER_BETWEEN is in AvailableTargets but has NO case in ai_v2 getTarget: it always resolves undefined, so any rule using it silently never fires. Only BARRIER_BLOCKING_CLOSEST_OPPONENT works (resolves barriers[0] on the path to closest enemy).
R51_barrier_between_dead_target.consequence: Lint: ban target BARRIER_BETWEEN in aiProfile rules.

R52_ai_rule_list_mechanics.law: Rules evaluate top-down; first rule producing a VALID action wins (invalid actions fall through to the next rule). Backup rules (when includeDefaultRules or the AI is a player-account AI) APPEND AFTER custom rules, not before: custom rules always get first shot. An unconditional end_turn rule is auto-appended whenever any effect-bearing action exists. If NO rule yields a valid action, the AI's curHealth is set to 0 ('%name is exhausted and has to give up') - real suicide. The auto end_turn is NOT appended when only non-effect actions (heal/meditate/flee/wait/move/replacement/cleanse/clear) remain, so an AI that runs out of affordable jutsu with no explicit end_turn/fallback rule kills itself.
R52_ai_rule_list_mechanics.consequence: Reinforces the existing move-fallback law and adds: every profile should terminate with an unconditional rule that can always fire (move fallback or end_turn).

R53_student_action_strip.law: rank STUDENT strips basicHeal, meditate, clear, cleanse, both stances, replacementTechnique, and flee from available actions (basic attack + move survive). Second consequence of the missing-rank AI create law: a defaulted-to-STUDENT AI is also action-crippled, not just stat-floored.

R54_ai_action_selection_quirks.law: use_highest_power_action/jutsu/item filters candidates by rule.action.effect (a tag type string, default 'damage'); omit or mistype the effect and it matches nothing and falls through. use_combo_action: getComboStatus suffix-matches the AI's action history against a PREFIX of comboIds; any break restarts the combo at comboIds[0]. All steps of a combo share the single rule target and are gated by that one rule's conditions.

R55_self_cast_reconfirmed.law: getTarget('SELF') returns the acting AI with distance 0; use_specific_jutsu + target SELF is a fully valid, firing path. Reconfirms the 2026-07-31 falsification of the old self-cast law. Diagnostic order stands: a matching-but-inert rule means severed equip link (law 18), not rule grammar.
